note: Coming up out of a browse: the head lifts clear of the foliage and the back straightens under it, ending at the idle stand. One-way, so it does NOT loop -- it begins at the browse hold `eat-loop` ends at, stated key-for-key. Shorter than `eat-down` because a browsing animal lowers its head deliberately and raises it to look around, and the tail drops to its carried angle last, after the head is already clear.
